target.title: test: speed timing-sensitive suites and harden LOC CI base
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Several timing-sensitive tests sleep through debounce, hover, reconnect, and lifecycle windows even when the behavior can be advanced deterministically. One managed-process test also waits for child processes to exit naturally. Separately, pull-request LOC checks can compare against a stale event-payload base after `main` advances.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Install Playwright's page clock and advance the six affected browser timing windows without wall-clock sleeps, preserving the same delay semantics.
- Terminate the managed child fixtures as soon as their listener invariant is observed.
- Preload the real Logbook view/controller through the existing `PluginPage` test seam, keeping the suite focused on lifecycle behavior instead of concurrent Vite transform latency.
- Derive the pull-request LOC comparison SHA from the checked-out synthetic merge commit's first parent, while retaining the push-event base behavior.
- Use the unambiguous sidebar new-session control in the existing UI E2E scenario.

Current `main` now owns the stronger changed-file LOC ratchet implementation, so this PR intentionally keeps only the complementary exact-base workflow hardening.

## User Impact

No runtime or user-visible behavior changes. Developers get faster, more deterministic test feedback and LOC checks use the exact tree represented by the pull-request merge checkout.

## Evidence

- Same-box profiling for the six optimized browser assertions: 25.38 s -> 12.25 s (51.7% faster).
- Same-box managed-child profiling: 635.0 ms -> 114.7 ms (82% faster); final merged-tree suite completed in 295 ms.
- Final merged-tree focused proof: 63/63 UI E2E tests and 63/63 tooling tests passed (`run_ef7d80634008`).
- Full UI current-main overlay: 236 files / 3,742 tests passed in 21.61 s (`run_63dc61fde623`).
- Final full UI attempt passed 3,741/3,742; the one untouched CodeMirror browser timeout passed 9/9 immediately in isolation (`run_957bcd0fa1d7`).
- Test types plus the explicit changed-file check gate passed (`run_e2b81e3137ae`).
- Fresh full-context autoreview: clean, `patch is correct` (0.93 confidence).

AI-assisted: yes.
